SELECT 
    CASE WHEN cnt1 > 1071 THEN avg_ext_tax1 ELSE avg_net_paid_inc_tax1 END AS bucket1,
    CASE WHEN cnt2 > 39161 THEN avg_ext_tax2 ELSE avg_net_paid_inc_tax2 END AS bucket2,
    CASE WHEN cnt3 > 29434 THEN avg_ext_tax3 ELSE avg_net_paid_inc_tax3 END AS bucket3,
    CASE WHEN cnt4 > 6568 THEN avg_ext_tax4 ELSE avg_net_paid_inc_tax4 END AS bucket4,
    CASE WHEN cnt5 > 21216 THEN avg_ext_tax5 ELSE avg_net_paid_inc_tax5 END AS bucket5
FROM (
    SELECT 
        COUNT(*) * 1071 AS cnt1, AVG(ss_ext_tax) AS avg_ext_tax1, AVG(ss_net_paid_inc_tax) AS avg_net_paid_inc_tax1,
        COUNT(*) * 39161 AS cnt2, AVG(ss_ext_tax) AS avg_ext_tax2, AVG(ss_net_paid_inc_tax) AS avg_net_paid_inc_tax2,
        COUNT(*) * 29434 AS cnt3, AVG(ss_ext_tax) AS avg_ext_tax3, AVG(ss_net_paid_inc_tax) AS avg_net_paid_inc_tax3,
        COUNT(*) * 6568 AS cnt4, AVG(ss_ext_tax) AS avg_ext_tax4, AVG(ss_net_paid_inc_tax) AS avg_net_paid_inc_tax4,
        COUNT(*) * 21216 AS cnt5, AVG(ss_ext_tax) AS avg_ext_tax5, AVG(ss_net_paid_inc_tax) AS avg_net_paid_inc_tax5
    FROM store_sales
    WHERE r_reason_sk = 1 AND ss_quantity BETWEEN 1 AND 100
) AS bucketed_sales
